input.rationale: Paragraph 18 is the exit provision. Paragraph 18.1 commits every Party, including Teleglobe, for a 25-year Initial Period and permits unilateral withdrawal only at or after the end of that period on one year's notice; paragraph 18.2 allows mid-term termination only by unanimous written agreement or a 90% Management Committee majority. There is therefore no Customer convenience exit at all in a multi-year term, which is expressly walk-away territory and fails both fallback elements on Customer notice. Paragraph 23 (default/capacity reclamation) is a for-cause mechanic and does not supply a convenience right. Conversely, the counterparty side is acceptable: no other Party may unilaterally withdraw during the Initial Period, and withdrawal at the end of the term requires a full year's notice, so the "no Vendor mid-term convenience right" element is already satisfied. We therefore add only the missing Teleglobe-only convenience right (30 days' notice) with a pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts, as a new Subparagraph 18.1A that leaves the other Parties' rights untouched. We have not disturbed the capital-cost forfeiture in the sentence following 18.5 ("No credit for capital costs will be made to a Party that terminates its participation in accordance with Subparagraph 18.1"), which is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule and, being keyed to Subparagraph 18.1, does not attach to a withdrawal under the new 18.1A.

proposal.summary: Add a Teleglobe-only convenience withdrawal right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18.1 locks us in for a 25-year Initial Period with no convenience exit, which is our walk-away position. We have added a Teleglobe-only right to withdraw for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts; the other Parties' exit right stays limited to the end of the Initial Period on one year's notice. If you prefer, we can move to our fallback of 60-90 days' notice with any early-termination fee capped at three months' charges.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Subparagraph 18.1, Teleglobe USA Inc. may terminate its participation in this Agreement for convenience at any time, including during the Initial Period, by giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties, and the other Parties shall refund to Teleglobe USA Inc., pro rata, any amounts prepaid by it in respect of the period after the effective date of such termination.
